title: Essential attributes: Wahdaniyyah, Mukhalafatun lil-hawadith, Qiyamun bi-nafsihi
intro: Allah is One, nothing is like Him, and He needs no one.

learn.text: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

learn.html: These three also belong to as-sifat adh-dhatiyyah, the attributes of Allah’s being:

learn.title: Wahdaniyyah – Allah is One
learn.html: Allah is absolutely One in everything – in His being, in His attributes and in His beautiful names. He has no partner and no associate. Thinking about everything that exists leads people to Allah’s Oneness.

learn.title: Mukhalafatun lil-hawadith – Allah is not like anyone or anything
learn.html: Allah is completely different from everything He created, even though His creations are like each other in many ways. Comparing Him with anyone or anything puts our belief in danger.

learn.title: Qiyamun bi-nafsihi – Allah exists by Himself
learn.html: Allah exists without anyone’s help, and nothing can question His existence. He needs nothing in order to exist, because He is perfect in everything. He is not limited by time or place.

learn.text: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined.

learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “Think about Allah’s creations, and do not think about Allah’s Being.” (Tabarani)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) told us that Allah, the Most High, says: “O My servants, it is all about your deeds, which I keep and count for you, and for which I will reward you. Whoever finds good, let him praise Allah; and whoever finds something else, let him blame no one but himself.” (Muslim)

How do we depend on Allah?
practice.prompt: Allah depends on no one – but we depend on Him. Tap everything we need from Allah, then tap Check.

options.why: Everything we have comes from Allah – only He needs no one.

options: Allah is not like anyone or anything
Allah exists by Himself and needs no one

questions.q: How does the Prophet (SAW) advise us to come to know Allah?
options: Think about Allah’s creations, not about His Being
Try to imagine what Allah looks like

questions.q: Which surah says “Nor is there to Him any equivalent”?

practice.title: Choose a task
